notes: Single variant — no risk levels, no alternative pay tables.
Royal Flush multiplier 812.9719437907615 is slightly higher than standard 9/6 Jacks or Better (800x).

'Zero Edge' is marketing: the 0.1% optimal-play house edge is implemented by the pay-table itself — the boosted royal_flush multiplier (812.97x vs the standard 9/6 800x) plus elevated straight_flush/four_of_a_kind multipliers lift the optimal-play RTP to exactly 99.9000%, vs 99.5439% for the standard 9/6 Jacks or Better baseline. The separate 'effective_edge' field in the bet response is the operator-side zero_edge_rakeback mechanism that refunds the 0.1% on top — not the source of the 99.9000%.
'none' = losing hand (no pair of Jacks or better, no better combination).
